title: Steps to create International Fund Transfer – Existing Beneficiary

steps.text: Login to the mobile application, Land on accounts dashboard (account landed in the debit account number) and click Transfer
Select existing beneficiary from the list
Transfer currency can be selected from drop down list
Enter beneficiary details ( name , address, purpose codes ) , Enter description (optional field)

Click on next to preview transfer details 
 a. Confirm: proceed with transfer  
 b. Back arrow to edit transfer details
